title: Reading
summary: A stable open book, eyes scan across it. No page flip or blank page appearing.

poses.label: Start line
poses.direction: Open C eyes glance down-left. Short calm closed mouth. A small open cyan outline book below and right of the face, with exactly three stable short cyan text strokes on each page.

poses.label: Across line
poses.direction: Same geometry, eyes glance down-right. The exact same rigid book remains in the same position, all three text strokes stay on both pages.

poses.label: Next line
poses.direction: Eyes glance slightly down-left, a little lower than first. Same closed mouth, same book, same six visible text strokes; nothing flips, disappears or changes sides.

cycle: Start line → across line → next line → across line; stable book throughout.
